claim: Alt ROM space is finite: call shared latch routines instead of inline macros when full, move state-page-only code to RAM, and check the size after every assemble.

evidence.text: With a full alt ROM one latch routine pair is called instead of macros inline (7 sites, 25 bytes); the alt ROM had 36 bytes left.
Alt ROM block ends at 0x3CFF with 1 byte left; the extra 13 bytes would not fit.
State-page-only code moved to RAM, keeping the ROM at 914 bytes; check the size after every assemble.
